key_objects.name_zh: 两个停止时刻下的 stopped-process 强 Markov 公式
key_objects.name_en: stopped-process strong Markov formula for two stopping times
key_objects.statement: If σ≤τ are stopping times and F is bounded Borel on R^d, the law of the process stopped at τ after time σ is obtained by averaging an independent Brownian motion started from the stopped location at σ.

key_objects.name_zh: stopped process 的双停止时刻积分恒等式
key_objects.name_en: two-stopping-time integral identity for the stopped process
key_objects.formula: ∫ F(B̂_{σ+t}) dP = ∫∫ F(B̂_t^{y(ω′)}(ω)) dP(ω)dP(ω′), with y(ω′)=B̂_σ(ω′)

key_objects.name_zh: 强 Markov 性质的条件期望形式
key_objects.name_en: conditional-expectation form of the strong Markov property
key_objects.description: The path-functional and stopped-process formulas remain valid when integrating over A∈A_σ, yielding conditional-expectation formulations relative to A_σ.

key_objects.name_zh: Brownian 退出分布 μ_x
key_objects.name_en: Brownian exit distribution μ_x

key_objects.name_zh: Dirichlet 解的 Brownian 表示
key_objects.name_en: Brownian representation of the Dirichlet solution

key_objects.name_zh: Brownian 表示给出 Dirichlet 问题的调和解
key_objects.name_en: Brownian representation solves the Dirichlet problem
key_objects.statement: For u defined by (20): (a) u is harmonic in R; (b) u(x)→f(y) as x→y from R whenever y is a regular boundary point.

key_objects.name_en: mean-value property on spheres

key_objects.name_en: Brownian motion stopping on S and then ∂R

key_objects.name_zh: Brownian 首次到达球面的分布为标准球面测度
key_objects.name_en: Brownian first-hit distribution on a centered sphere is uniform

key_objects.name_zh: 从球面停止时刻继续到边界的强 Markov 恒等式
key_objects.name_en: strong-Markov identity from sphere hitting to boundary exit

key_objects.name_zh: 正则边界点处退出时刻趋零
key_objects.name_en: exit-time concentration at a regular boundary point

key_objects.name_zh: 退出位置在正则边界点附近集中
key_objects.name_en: exit-location concentration near a regular boundary point
key_objects.formula: P({ω:|y-B^x_{τ_x(ω)}(ω)|>s})<ε for x sufficiently close to y

key_objects.name_zh: 截断锥 Γ
key_objects.name_en: truncated cone Γ

key_objects.name_zh: 外锥条件蕴含边界点正则
key_objects.name_en: outside cone condition implies regularity
key_objects.statement: If x∈∂R and x+Γ is disjoint from R for some truncated cone Γ, then x is a regular boundary point.

key_objects.name_zh: 边界点外侧截断锥
key_objects.name_en: truncated exterior cone at a boundary point

key_objects.name_zh: outside cone condition
key_objects.name_en: outside cone condition
key_objects.description: A bounded open R satisfies the outside cone condition if every x∈∂R admits a truncated cone Γ with x+Γ disjoint from R.

key_objects.name_zh: 外锥条件下 Dirichlet 问题存在唯一连续调和解
key_objects.name_en: existence and uniqueness for the Dirichlet problem under the outside cone condition
key_objects.statement: If bounded open R satisfies the outside cone condition and f is continuous on ∂R, there is a unique u continuous on closure(R), harmonic in R, with boundary value f.

key_objects.name_zh: 随机游走增量分布的 Gaussian 弱收敛
key_objects.name_en: weak convergence of rescaled random-walk increments to Gaussian laws
key_objects.description: Show S_t^(N) converges weakly to ν_t, and S_t^(N)-S_s^(N) to ν_{t-s}.

key_objects.name_zh: 路径空间 (P,d) 的完备性与可分性
key_objects.name_en: completeness and separability of path space (P,d)
key_objects.description: Verify P is complete and separable.

key_objects.name_zh: 路径空间 P 不是 σ-compact
key_objects.name_en: path space P is not sigma-compact
key_objects.description: Use Baire category to show P cannot be sigma-compact.

key_objects.name_zh: 紧致度量空间及 C(X) 的可分性
key_objects.name_en: separability of compact metric spaces and C(X)
key_objects.description: Show a compact metric space X and C(X) are separable.

key_objects.name_zh: 紧集上连续函数的等范数延拓
key_objects.name_en: norm-preserving continuous extension from a compact set
key_objects.description: Extend continuous f on compact K⊂X to F on X with the same sup norm.

key_objects.name_zh: 紧路径族的一致模连续性
key_objects.name_en: uniform modulus of continuity for a compact family of paths
key_objects.description: For compact K⊂P and T>0, construct w_T(h)→0 controlling all increments uniformly.

key_objects.name_zh: 弱收敛测度对开集的 Portmanteau 型结论
key_objects.name_en: Portmanteau-type consequences for open sets under weak convergence
key_objects.description: If μ_N→μ weakly, prove the liminf inequality on open sets and convergence when the boundary is μ-null.

key_objects.name_zh: Wiener measure 与 Brownian motion 实现的等价性
key_objects.name_en: equivalence between Wiener measure and Brownian-motion realizations
key_objects.description: Show canonical Wiener measure realizes Brownian motion and conversely cylindrical finite-dimensional laws extend to W.

key_objects.name_zh: 严格 Brownian process 与其唯一性
key_objects.name_en: strict Brownian processes and uniqueness up to null sets
key_objects.description: Construct the strict quotient process and prove uniqueness of strict Brownian realizations up to null sets.

key_objects.name_zh: Rd 值独立同分布变量的 Khinchin 型不等式
key_objects.name_en: Khinchin-type inequality for bounded iid R^d-valued variables
key_objects.description: Prove ||Σ a_n f_n||_p≤A_p(Σ|a_n|^2)^{1/2} for bounded iid mean-zero variables.

key_objects.name_zh: 部分和最大值的高阶尾界
key_objects.name_en: higher-order tail bound for maxima of partial sums
key_objects.description: Prove limsup m{sup_{k≤n}|s_k|>λ√n}=O(λ^{-p}) for every p>0.

key_objects.name_zh: Brownian motion 在无穷远处的强大数律型增长界
key_objects.name_en: strong-law-type growth bound for Brownian motion at infinity
key_objects.description: Show |B_t|=O(t^{1/2+ε}) almost everywhere for every ε>0.

key_objects.name_zh: 时间反演 tB_{1/t} 仍是 Brownian motion
key_objects.name_en: time inversion tB_{1/t} is Brownian motion
key_objects.description: Show B_t′=tB_{1/t} is again Brownian motion.

key_objects.name_zh: Brownian 路径不是 Hölder 1/2 且最终离开任意球
key_objects.name_en: Brownian paths are not Holder 1/2 and eventually exit every ball
key_objects.description: Show limsup_{t→0}|B_t|/√t=∞ and limsup_{t→∞}|B_t|/√t=∞ almost everywhere.
